sources.location: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2024/01/PXD047109/txt.zip (summary.txt, parameters.txt, proteinGroups.txt header read by HTTP range; stored entries)

claims.evidence: 12 RAW files in PRIDE; each claimed once. txt.zip is a MaxQuant output archive, not a raw archive.
MaxQuant summary.txt maps Raw file to Experiment (e.g. Prot122_5 = LGB 14h-1). Paper: WT and beta-lactoglobulin strains sampled at 14 and 24 h, experimental duplicates.

These 4 RAW files are absent from summary.txt/proteinGroups; condition not stated anywhere. The paper also made an alpha-lactalbumin (LALBA) strain; by file order these may be LALBA 14h/24h but this is not documented, so left unassigned.
Cultured bacterium, secretome of culture supernatant; no anatomical source.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M variable; Acetyl Protein N-term variable

claims.evidence: Rehydration buffer with 20 mM DTT; 50 mM chloroacetamide alkylation in FASP filters.
Main-search precursor tolerance not written in parameters.txt.
One RAW per sample, no fractionation described.

limitations: Paper does not contain a table mapping RAW files to samples; mapping comes from MaxQuant summary.txt only (8 of 12 files).
Four RAW files (Prot122_3,4,9,10) have no stated condition; rows carry not available and biological replicate 1 as a placeholder.
The -1/-2 experiment suffixes are treated as biological replicates (paper: experimental duplicates, three biological growth replicates for curves); unconfirmed.

Precursor tolerance, MS2 analyzer, fractionation, culture medium and growth conditions not annotated in structured columns; the genotype value for LGB is our descriptive text for the pECLGB plasmid (no strain ontology column in ms-proteomics).
characteristics[genotype], factor value[genotype] and factor value[sampling time] are outside the ms-proteomics template column set; sampling time uses sample-metadata pattern (number + hour).
